name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the contestant's response directly addresses the user's prompt or instruction.

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and consistency of the response, ensuring that it makes sense as a whole.

name: Completeness
description: The extent to which the response fully answers or addresses all parts of the user's prompt.

name: Clarity
description: The ease with which the response can be understood by the user, free of ambiguity or confusion.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and innovativeness of the response, offering unique insights or perspectives.

name: Accuracy
description: The correctness of the information provided in the response, based on factual evidence or logical reasoning.
